description_en: Modifies the information of a resource share
kebab_example: aliyun resourcesharing update-resource-share --resource-share-id rs-qSkW1HBY0000 --resource-share-name new --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateResourceShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name for the resource share.

The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.

It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
新的共享单元名称。

长度范围：1~50个字符。

格式：允许输入英文字母、数字、中文、英文句点（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: resource_share_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to share resources with accounts outside your resource directory. Valid values:

false

true
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许共享给资源目录外的账号。取值：

false：仅允许资源目录内共享。
true：允许共享给任意账号
parameters.name: allow_external_targets

ResourceShare.description_en: The information about the resource share

AllowExternalTargets.description_en:
Indicates whether resources can be shared with accounts outside your resource directory. Valid values:

false

true
AllowExternalTargets.description_zh:
是否允许共享给资源目录外的账号。取值：

false：仅允许资源目录内共享。
true：允许共享给任意账号

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource share was created

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

ResourceShareOwner.description_en: The owner of the resource share

ResourceShareStatus.description_en:
The status of the resource share. Valid values:

Active: The resource share is enabled.

Pending: The resource share is waiting for confirmation.

Deleting: The resource share is being deleted.

Deleted: The resource share is deleted.

The system automatically deletes the records of resource shares in the `Deleted` state within 48 to 96 hours
ResourceShareStatus.description_zh:
共享单元状态。取值：

Active：已启用。
Pending：待确认。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除。

Deleted状态的共享单元记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource share was updated
